About the Clinic

Warm, Personal Dental Care in the Heart of Moonwalk

At AFJ Medina Dental Clinic, a healthy smile should be within everyone's reach. This is a neighborhood practice where you're treated like family — not just a patient. Dr. Medina takes the time to actually listen, explain what's going on, and make sure you leave feeling confident about your care. Whether it's a routine cleaning or something more involved, every visit is made as comfortable and stress-free as possible.

  • Modern, sanitized facility Clean, well-maintained equipment and treatment rooms for every visit.
  • Patient-centered approach Every treatment plan is explained clearly, with your comfort in mind.
  • Convenient Moonwalk location Easy to find near Wow Hair Salon along E. Rodriguez, Moonwalk.
What We Offer

Complete Dental Services

From routine cleanings to advanced restorative treatments, the clinic offers comprehensive care for your smile.

Oral Prophylaxis

Cleaning / Linis

Professional teeth cleaning to remove plaque and tartar, keeping your gums healthy.

Tooth Restoration

Pasta

Durable fillings that repair decayed or damaged teeth and restore natural function.

Oral Surgery

Tooth Extraction / Bunot

Safe and comfortable removal of damaged, impacted, or problematic teeth.

Orthodontic Treatment

Braces

Gradually straighten and align teeth for a healthier bite and confident smile.

Root Canal Treatment

Endodontics

Relieve pain and save infected teeth by treating the innermost part of the tooth.

Prosthodontic Treatment

Restorative Care

Custom-designed solutions to replace missing teeth and restore your bite.

Dentures

Complete & Removable Partial

Custom-fit complete or partial dentures to bring back your smile and chewing comfort.

Jacket Crowns

Crowns

Full-coverage crowns that protect and strengthen weakened or damaged teeth.

Fixed Bridge

Tooth Replacement

A permanent, natural-looking solution to fill the gap left by missing teeth.
